test_cases.name: Focus Invalid Before Typing Begins
test_cases.scenario_description: Target HWND set to non-existent window handle before dispatch.
test_cases.expected_outcome: Immediate pre-dispatch abort; state = SAFE_ABORT; 0 characters dispatched.
test_cases.notes: Pre-dispatch verification checked IsWindow() and fast_check_foreground(), halting execution.

test_cases.name: Focus Loss During Active Typing Stream
test_cases.scenario_description: Focus shifts away from target window during continuous character stream.
test_cases.expected_outcome: Stream halts cleanly upon focus change detection; 0 post-cancellation leaks.
test_cases.notes: Re-check validation halted stream immediately upon focus loss notification.

test_cases.name: Target Window Destroyed Mid-Stream
test_cases.scenario_description: Target HWND is abruptly closed/destroyed while ORBIT typing stream is in flight.
test_cases.expected_outcome: IsWindow() detection triggers immediate SAFE_ABORT; 0 blind injections to destroyed handle.
test_cases.notes: IsWindow(hwnd) cycle detected handle destruction and prevented dangling keystroke injection.

test_cases.name: Rapid Alternating Focus Switching Stress
test_cases.scenario_description: Attempted 100 Hz rapid alternating focus switching between two active test windows.
test_cases.expected_outcome: Measure actual achieved switching rate vs requested rate; record OS throttling boundaries.
test_cases.evidence_classification: LIVE OS + EMPIRICAL FOCUS RATE MEASUREMENT
test_cases.notes: Requested Switching Rate: 100 Hz (20 iterations at 10ms interval). Achieved Rate: 0.0 Hz across 0.21s (0 successful, 20 restricted by Windows SetForegroundWindow UIPI/lockout rules).
